video.title: AI欧腐《我资助的女孩抢走了我的男人/My Sponsored Girl Stole My Man》
video.desc:
给我笑吐了 渣男HIV报应
After ten years of marriage, Elliot discovers that Gareth, the man he sacrificed everything for, has betrayed him with Lena—Elliot’s former scholarship student. Elliot walks away without looking back. But as Gareth and Lena drown in lies, scandal, and the consequences of their affair, Elliot finds the love he was always meant to have with his longtime admirer, Oliver.
结婚十年后，Elliot终于发现，自己曾为之付出一切的男人Gareth，竟然背叛了他，和Lena搞在了一起。
而Lena，正是Elliot曾经资助过的女学生。
看清真相后，Elliot没有纠缠，也没有回头，而是决然离开。与此同时，Gareth和Lena却在谎言、丑闻，以及这段背叛带来的后果中越陷越深。
最终，Elliot在一直默默爱慕他的Oliver身边，找到了那个原本就该属于他的真爱。
